notes: Four read-only features. What changed: a daily background config snapshot (startup entries, scheduled tasks, services, programs, drivers, tweaks) with an added/removed/changed diff between any two, so 'my PC got weird lately' has an answer. Storage explorer: sizes the folders under a drive or path, largest first, drill down by click. Tools gains a pending-restart check (and why), a WinSxS component-store analysis with the safe Microsoft cleanup, and battery health (wear, cycles, runtime) on laptops. The Startup boot card gained a last-12-boots trend. Plus an audit pass: the updater re-verifies the installer immediately before running it, unquoted startup paths resolve, and a few smaller fixes.
